craft_notes: Sthāyin: Courage of refuge (utsāha). Em-dash→colon (sung stated, spur sued). Rejected: 'prick' for 'spur' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Thee the Verse sings, whose mind-kindling splendour spurs:
spur ours, prithee, liege, down the loyal lane.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ

reads_against.argmap: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-radiance impelling. → May Gāyatrī-sung impeller guide thoughts truly.
c1_essence: Chant-sung thought-blaze urged straight; eight-bodied asked for lasting ground or all.

l2.plain_english: The chant hymns his thought-kindling blaze — O may he urge our minds down the straight track, our lord.
l2.sanskrit_cite: gāyatryā gīyate yasya dhiyāṃ tejaḥ pracodakam codayed api kaccin naḥ sa dhiyaḥ satpathe prabhuḥ

reads_against.t1: By Gāyatrī is sung whose thought-radiance impelling — may he impel, I hope, our thoughts on the true path, the lord.
